title: Energizing Buddha Bowl
description: A refreshing and healthy Chinese-inspired bowl filled with energizing ingredients for a perfect snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
2. Steam the mixed vegetables until tender.
3. In a small bowl, mix together yogurt, honey, and sesame seeds.
4. In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, steamed vegetables, and yogurt mixture.
5. Sprinkle with fresh herbs and serve immediately.
6. If desired, add a small portion of your favorite protein (such as tofu or chicken).
7. Garnish with additional sesame seeds and herbs if desired.
9. Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
